description.content:
List all rate limit overrides, optionally filtered by type.

Query parameters:
- override_type: 'org' or 'user' to filter results
- limit: Maximum number of results (default: 100, max: 1000)

query.description: Filter by type: 'org' or 'user'. If not provided, returns all overrides.

description.content:
Get a rate limit override by identifier.

Identifier format: 'org:<org_id>' or 'user:<user_id>'

Example: /internal/rate-limits/overrides/org:org_123

Update an existing rate limit override.

Only the fields provided in the request will be updated.

Delete a rate limit override.

After deletion, the org/user will fall back to default rate limits.

Manually invalidate the cache for a specific rate limit override.

Useful for debugging or forcing a cache refresh.
